description: This file defines a custom exception class MemoryStorageEtagMismatchException used within the Orleans.Storage.Internal namespace. The class is designed to signal an ETag mismatch in memory storage, providing properties for stored and received ETags, and methods for serialization and conversion to an InconsistentStateException.
